description: The plot illustrates the relationship between the number of queries used during inference and the MRR@10 metric for different DPR configurations. The x-axis is labeled “Number of queries used during inference (S.)” and has a linear scale ranging from 1 to 10, with tick labels at each integer value. The y-axis is labeled “MRR@10” and has a linear scale ranging from 33.0 to 36.5, with tick labels at intervals of 0.5.  A brown dashed line, labeled “DPR w/o query”, begins at approximately 35.3 when S is 1 and remains relatively stable at approximately 35.4 across the x-axis. A yellow solid line, labeled “DPR w/ gold”, starts at approximately 33.2 when S is 1 and increases to approximately 36.2 when S is 10. A purple solid line, labeled “DPR w/ top-1”, begins at approximately 34.8 when S is 1 and remains relatively stable at approximately 35.2 across the x-axis. A blue dashed line, labeled “DPR w/ random”, starts at approximately 35.1 when S is 1 and remains relatively stable at approximately 35.1 across the x-axis. A red dashed line, labeled “DPR w/ curriculum”, begins at approximately 35.3 when S is 1 and increases to approximately 36.3 when S is 10. A green solid line, labeled “DPR w/ bottom-1”, starts at approximately 34.4 when S is 1 and increases to approximately 35.8 when S is 10.
